# Plan the Implementation

Read first:

- `specs/00-overview.md`
- `specs/01-functional-requirements.md`
- `specs/02-api-contract.md`
- `specs/03-domain-rules.md`
- `specs/04-data-model.md`
- `specs/05-startup-and-import.md`
- `specs/06-testing-strategy.md`
- `specs/07-acceptance-criteria.md`

Do not implement code.

Inspect the repository and produce an executable implementation plan.

Cover:

- current repository state;
- stack;
- architecture;
- data model;
- startup/import flow;
- business-rule algorithm;
- API boundary;
- integration-test strategy;
- configuration;
- risks;
- implementation order.

Check the plan against every acceptance criterion.

Do not invent requirements.

Conclude with architecture decisions that require approval before implementation.
